title: Reading a Prescription
description: This episode of Focus Cast by focuslinks walks one simple spectacle prescription from the left edge of the form to the right, spoken entirely in plain words. Listeners learn to name the eye rows first, read the sphere values with their signs, and understand the gentle role of pupillary distance. Richer features like cylinder, axis, and add power are deliberately saved for the next installment. The episode closes by calmly dismantling the myth that different values for the two eyes must mean a mistake.
